text.tspan: From Local Commit to Merged Pull Request
Committing saves your work. Pushing shares it. Merging makes it the team's.
Steps 1 and 6 happen on your computer. Steps 2 to 5 happen on GitHub, where the whole team can see them.
This is the loop a professional developer repeats several times a week. Nothing reaches master without review.
